worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.summary: Hold the nozzle and pour a sustained jet of flame: it grows forward each tick, then holds at full length, sweeping a lane (or a fan) in front. The spray runs about 20 ticks split into 4 contact pulses - a foe standing in the fire takes one share every 5 ticks and must stay to take them all. Caught targets may ignite. Let go and it stops at once; walls cut the flame short.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.0: Hold the nozzle and pin a lane under flame
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.1: Sweep everyone stacked in one lane
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.use.2: Hold a whole fan of foes in a sustained burn
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.descripti: The flame advances %3$s blocks/tick out to %2$s blocks; over one spray it deals at most %1$s special damage to a single target, split into 4 contact pulses - only a target that stays takes them all.

The combined chance to ignite over the whole spray is %1$s; each contact pulse rolls its equivalent share, so all four add up to that value, never four times. A burn lasts about 40 s: the target loses about 1/16 of its maximum health every 5 s and its physical attacks deal half damage. Fire-type targets cannot be ignited.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.wide.on: Fan: opens about %1$s degrees and ignition +5%%, catching more targets, but total power x0.82, length x0.78, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.wide.off: Focused: a narrow lance with a lateral radius of about %1$s blocks, heavier on one target, farther and faster, at the cost of coverage.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.growth.0: From level %1$s the total spray rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks long.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.growth.1: From level %1$s the total spray rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks long.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.preferenc: On: opens about 30 degrees, spray ignition +5%%, catching more targets, but total power x0.82, length x0.78, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown. Off (focused): a narrow lance, heavier on one target, farther and faster, at the cost of coverage.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: prefers the jet when another enemy is within 3 blocks of the target, holding the nozzle to burn a whole lane; off: order by ordinary attack only.
worldcombat.skill.flamethrower.descripti: The whole jet can scorch at most %1$s different targets.

The spray runs about %1$s, split into 4 contact pulses; hold to keep pouring and steer tick by tick, and releasing or being interrupted stops it at once; solid walls cut the flame, so there is no fire damage through walls.
The user stands still while pouring the flame.
